thread:
Maya (SRE): Observed many postmortem actions drifting. Idea: lightweight 'closure routine' with 4 fields on every action: owner, due_by (auto-fill by severity), verification, recurrence_tag. Thoughts?
Ben (PM): Strong yes. Auto-fill would help. Suggest severity->due mapping: Sev0=5d, Sev1=14d, Sev2=45d.
Lina (Oncall): Add rule: if no owner in 48h, escalate to IC. IC assigns within 24h or reassigns.
Omar (Infra): Also include a runbook_update boolean for infra-facing changes so docs are kept current.
Maya (SRE): Proposed comms cadence: incident alert -> 24h status -> postmortem + action queue link when verification done. Keep all updates in #incidents.
ops-bot: Ops Bot: created TASK-4591 from postmortem "db-timeout-spiral" assigned to oncall-rotation due 2026-04-02.
Ben (PM): For recurring incidents, tag with rec:<service>. Add recurrence_score increment when same stacktrace/service appears within 30 days. If score>=3, flag for a deep-dive in the monthly ops retro.
Lina (Oncall): Can we require a 15m weekly triage to clear or reassign stale actions? Rotate facilitator between oncall and SRE lead.
Omar (Infra): I'll add a "cost_estimate" field (est. downtime minutes, customers affected) so PMs can triage by impact.
Maya (SRE): Verification checklist will be required to mark Done (metrics check, smoke test, canary). I'll add a template snippet to the PM checklist.
Ben (PM): I'll update the postmortem template and doc the escalation flow. Plan to roll this out next Monday.
Lina (Oncall): Thanks 44d. Ping me if you want me to run the first triage.
